title: New on the Shelf: 5 Non-Alcoholic Beers Just In at NA Beer Market
excerpt: An olive oil pilsner, a pecan pie fall brew and three more new NA beers just landed. Grab single cans and build your own 12-pack.
intro:
Fresh cans just hit the shelf, and this batch has range. There's a pilsner brewed with olive oil, a fall brew built around pecan pie, and a couple of easy drinkers for weekend football and the early Thanksgiving prep.

Whatever your reason for reaching for an NA beer, here are five new ones worth a spot in your fridge. Every one is a single can, so mix them into a Build Your Own 12-Pack and try them all.

blurbs.41163: Athletic teamed up with Graza on this one, and yes, it's brewed with extra virgin olive oil. It still drinks like a classic pils, smooth and crisp, with an herbal edge that makes it a great match for anything salty off the grill or the cutting board.
blurbs.41160: Toasted pecans and dark brown sugar over a deep ruby malt base. This limited fall release is the closest thing to dessert in a can, and it's built for sweater weather and the Thanksgiving table.
blurbs.41083: Golden-straw in the glass with a floral aroma and a light touch of honey, this is a classic American-style beer with a crisp snap at the finish. Keep a few cold for game day this weekend.
blurbs.41063: Inspired by Sawtooth Brewery's False Summit Amber, Prospect pairs Idaho 2-row and caramel malt with Cascade and Saaz hops for a balance of malty sweetness and earthy citrus. A great pick for a cool fall evening if you like a beer with a little more body.
blurbs.41020: Rakau, El Dorado and Idaho 7 hops bring big tropical and citrus aroma, with no fruit in the kettle. Juicy, medium-bodied and barely bitter. Only a few cans left, so don't wait on this one.

outro: Can't pick just one? Mix any of these into a Build Your Own 12-Pack at nabeermarket.com and discover your new favorite NA beer, with free shipping to all 50 states. If you'd rather have someone pick for you each month, NA Beer Club has you covered.
